rows.conflict: Publishing-source guidance permits any existing branch; 404 checklist requires main/default.
rows.requirement: Parameterize selected source branch; verify configured native source and build receipt. Do not impose main-only rule from conflicting checklist.
rows.negative_test: Nondefault authorized source must not fail solely because of its name; nonexistent source must not pass.

rows.conflict: 404 HTML-only repository wording is narrower than creation guide Markdown/README and generated artifact options.
rows.requirement: Inspect effective deployed artifact entry and source mode, not just repository index.html.
rows.negative_test: Repository file with missing artifact entry must not pass; generated entry is not rejected solely for absence in repository.

rows.conflict: Management procedure treats AAAA optional, summary says all A/AAAA; HTTPS support list omits AAAA.
rows.requirement: Record provider-supported record type and intended IPv4/IPv6 profile; independently verify current endpoints before implementation.
rows.negative_test: Do not require AAAA without adopted profile or infer IPv6 HTTPS unsupported from omission.

rows.conflict: Management redirects toward selected apex/www; troubleshooting describes www-to-apex only.
rows.requirement: Expected redirect destination follows configured canonical domain; verify actual status, Location and final response.
rows.negative_test: Hardcoded apex destination must not pass when canonical domain is www.

rows.conflict: Management settings commit describes source-branch root; troubleshooting says publishing-source root. Custom Actions ignores CNAME.
rows.requirement: Separate DNS CNAME from repository CNAME; inspect branch/folder versus custom Actions mode and actual native custom-domain association.
rows.negative_test: CNAME file alone must not certify custom Actions domain configuration; docs-folder layout ambiguity remains explicit.

rows.conflict: One hour HTTPS availability versus 24-hour option/DNS propagation are different conditions.
rows.requirement: Track DNS propagation, certificate state, enforcement setting and effective HTTPS separately with timestamps.
rows.negative_test: Checkbox availability or elapsed wait cannot substitute for observed TLS and redirect behavior.

rows.conflict: Creation advises ignoring Gemfile.lock and latest supported dependency; reproducibility requires resolved identity evidence.
rows.requirement: Propose reviewed resolved dependencies and runtime identity without silently adopting upstream lock omission.
rows.negative_test: Mutable version guidance alone cannot certify reproducible hosted/local parity.

rows.conflict: Source copy path _default.html differs from destination default.html; copying introduces per-file rights requirements.
rows.requirement: Verify actual upstream layout identity and license for exact intended reuse before implementation.
rows.negative_test: Missing source layout, unknown license or unreviewed copied template cannot be marked verified.

rows.conflict: Actions source/environment creation does not associate a unique workflow or install protection; manual trigger deployment condition incompletely specified.
rows.requirement: Verify exact deploying workflow, event/branch identity, effective environment rules and authorized denial/recovery behavior.
rows.negative_test: Environment existence, workflow file or recent-run link must not be treated as native enforcement.

limitations: Proposals and negative-test requirements are not implemented bindings or test receipts.
Source receipt coverage is not omission-completeness assurance, policy acceptance or rights clearance.
No native pilot or estate settings changed.
